author_instruction: Organize only Survey, Idea, and ExperimentDesign evidence. Preserve DESIGN_ONLY status; do not claim tested closure, reliability, health outcomes, crew performance, ISRU throughput, or settlement certification.
core_conclusion: Permanent off-Earth habitation is an unverified system-of-systems capability whose credible evidence requires commodity-specific closure, resilient power, repair/ISRU quality, and human-safety margins under integrated failures.
